name: Resample
author: ShoveD01
description: Records what the MPC is playing (sequence and pads, optionally mixed with the line input) into a new mono or stereo sample and puts it on a pad. Length can be a number of bars from the tempo, or as much as fits in sample memory.
how_to_use: Set L (length: MAX / 1/4 / 1/2 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 bars), the source (OUT = MPC output, MIX = plus the line input; the OS Record page source must be IN for MIX), M (input monitoring - / +) and 1CH / 2CH
SHIFT + pad starts recording; the sample will go on that pad (current bank)
SHIFT + any pad stops: the sample is finished, becomes the current sample and is put on the pad (mono voice overlap, mute group 1)
A fixed length stops by itself. Pads without SHIFT are left to the OS.
